title: ralphs craftable uncraftables!
description: this mod adds ways to craft things that werent able to be crafted before!
body: a very simple mod that adds new ways to craft alot of uncrafted items! this is more of a silly mod honestly that instead of heavily aiming to be balanced, fair, and useful more prioritizes being fun to play with. for example i added a recipe for bedrock that just requires 9 deepslate because i i wondered what would happen if you could make bedrock lol this mod in the future will propably add more things! for example, light blocks? or the uncraftable potion only avalible using commands? i dont know! it also as its main feature adds spawn eggs and spawners which i just made because i didnt want to go through the pain of finding  a fortress every time i need blazes (especially in other mods that need blazes for stuff like create) so mainly this is just a fun lil mod i quickly made up. if your gonna play, enjoy! and thx.
